label: Logical falsity, from reciprocal moving and priority requiring nonmutual dependence
description: With one respect-free PriorSimply and one DependsForBeing: the case and 6ca87431 give PriorSimply y x and PriorSimply x y; the bridge 47aff057 then gives D x y ∧ ¬ D y x and D y x ∧ ¬ D x y, a contradiction. No transitivity or irreflexivity premise is used. A rejection could target 6ca87431's respect-free consequent, 47aff057, or the case premise; nothing here chooses among them. Lane B's reading: on priority in causing the fault lies with respect-free priority, on priority in being with taking cross-respect moving to yield priority in being.
